subject: Closing GitHub issues via pull requests

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Closing GitHub issues via pull requests
parts:
If you're creating a pull request and want it to close the issue when it's merged automatically, put one of these keywords and the issue number in the commit message:
  • close
  • closes
  • closed
  • fix
  • fixes
  • fixed
  • resolve
  • resolves
  • resolved
For more details:
https://help.github.com/articles/closing-issues-via-commit-messages/


Daniel
